Found a second, different Toast URL whose slug and page content both match the work-list address (4301 La Jolla Village Dr Suite 2040, San Diego, CA 92122) exactly - confirmed via window.__OO_STATE__ ROOT_QUERY.restaurantV2ByShortUrl.location.address1. This capture is an Apollo Client normalized cache (top-level keys ROOT_QUERY + Menu:<guid>), not a flat object - menu items/prices live inline under the Menu:<guid> object's groups[].items[].prices[0], a shape not previously seen on this batch. 11 sections, 37 raw items; dropped 4 items explicitly labeled '—Coming Soon' in their own names (not yet orderable/priced for real), leaving 33 filed. Cents cluster on two values only: .00 (mains/large plates, 27 items) and .79 (rice/noodles/desserts/beverages, 10 of the raw 37, fewer after Coming-Soon drop) - a clean two-tier house pricing convention, not a scattered/uniform-divisor pattern, so no markup detected.

dishes.name: STIR-FRIED PORK WITH PEPPERS 辣椒炒肉（黑猪肉）
dishes.description: A signature dish at Chef Fei, built around tender Berkshire pork and fresh peppers, expertly stir-fried over intense heat by our chefs. Smoky, savory, and deeply flavorful, with bold wok aroma that makes it one of the most iconic dishes in Chinese stir-fry cuisine.

dishes.name: STEAMED PORK RIBS WITH TARO 香芋蒸排骨
dishes.description: Tender pork ribs steamed until juicy, with taro that turns soft and creamy as it absorbs the savory juices. Comforting, delicate, and deeply home-style. A longtime favorite among younger diners.

dishes.name: CRISPY PINEAPPLE ORANGE CHICKEN 菠萝橙皮鸡
dishes.description: Crisp-tender chicken glazed in a bright orange sauce with a tropical note of pineapple. Sweet, citrusy, and lively, with a polished balance of fruit and savory flavor.

dishes.name: SPICY BRAISED CHICKEN WINGS 火辣鸡翅
dishes.description: Chicken wings tossed in a fiery house sauce. Bold, aromatic, and addictive, with dry chili heat that builds bite after bite.

dishes.name: CRISPY WALNUT SHRIMP 酥皮核桃大虾
dishes.description: Crisp shrimp finished in a glossy sweet-and-tangy sauce with a nutty crunch. Playful yet refined, with a contrast of juicy seafood and delicate crispness.

dishes.name: GLASS NOODLE CLAY POT WITH SEAFOOD SAUCE 海鲜酱粉丝煲
dishes.description: A Chef Fei classic. Silky glass noodles stir-fried in a clay pot with our signature seafood sauce and finished with caviar for an extra layer of savory umami. Rich, aromatic, and deeply flavorful, with every strand soaking up the essence of the seafood sauce

dishes.name: CLAY POT TOFU 砂锅豆腐煲
dishes.description: Soft tofu braised in a clay pot with pork cracklings, Chinese chives, fresh garlic, and bird's eye chilies. Rich, comforting, and full of texture, with a silky tofu contrast to the crispy pork cracklings. A longtime favorite among Chef Fei's returning guests.

dishes.name: SMASHED CHILI EGGPLANT WITH CENTURY EGG 擂辣椒皮蛋茄子
dishes.description: A bold Hunan classic where smoky eggplant, green chili pepper, and century egg are mashed together by hand. Silky, earthy, and deeply savory, with a rustic texture that feels unmistakably regional.

dishes.name: HOUSE SPECIAL BEEF FRIED RICE 招牌和牛炒饭
dishes.description: Fluffy basmati rice wok-fried with diced American Wagyu beef until fragrant and golden. Clean, simple, and precise, made to pair beautifully with bold Hunan flavors.

dishes.name: ORGANIC LETTUCE SALAD 橄榄油炝有机生菜
dishes.description: Organic lettuce selected for its crisp, juicy texture. Light, fragrant, and refreshing, with a subtle chili-garlic aroma.

dishes.name: WOOD EAR MUSHROOM SALAD 醋溜云耳
dishes.description: A classic Hunan-style appetizer featuring wood ear mushrooms with a crisp, springy bite and a bright black vinegar finish. Refreshing, lightly spicy, and an ideal start before richer dishes.

dishes.name: CUCUMBER SALAD 凉拌小黄瓜
dishes.description: Cool, crunchy cucumbers dressed in a clean garlic-chili style. Bright, refreshing, and simple in the best way—made to wake up the palate.

dishes.name: ORGANIC TOMATO SALAD 凉拌有机西红柿
dishes.description: Juicy Organic tomatoes served chilled with a delicate touch of sweetness. A nostalgic Chinese summer dish that is light, bright, and naturally refreshing.

dishes.name: CHICKEN VEGETABLE SOUP 有机时蔬炖鸡汤
dishes.description: A clear, comforting chicken soup gently simmered for a clean savory depth. Light yet nourishing, with the delicate sweetness of seasonal vegetables and a warm ginger finish.

dishes.name: STIR-FRIED BEEF WITH PEPPERS 费大厨辣椒炒牛肉（美国和牛&有机西兰花）
dishes.description: Tender slices of American Wagyu beef and organic broccoli are fired quickly in the wok by our skilled chefs to develop a bold, smoky wok aroma. Rich, juicy, and deeply flavorful, this is a refined take on a classic Hunan stir-fry favorite.

dishes.name: STEAMED ORGANIC EGG CUSTARD 蒸有机鸡蛋
dishes.description: Silky steamed organic egg custard with a soft, delicate texture. Comforting and elegant, with the option to add minced pork for extra savory richness.

dishes.name: GOLDEN PAN-FRIED EGGS 香煎金钱蛋
dishes.description: Boiled Organic eggs are sliced and then pan-seared until golden, then topped with flavorful minced Berkshire pork. Crispy, savory, and deeply satisfying, this dish turns simple ingredients into something memorable.

dishes.name: ASPARAGUS WITH BACON 芦笋炒培根
dishes.description: Crisp asparagus meets smoky bacon in a quick, aromatic wok stir-fry. Savory, fresh, and lightly spicy, with a clean snap in every bite.

dishes.name: HUNAN SPICY BRAISED ASSORTMENT 湘辣热卤
dishes.description: Pork tongue, pig ear, and pressed tofu stir-fried over high heat with fresh chilies and scallions. Coated in our signature Hunan chili seasoning for a rich, savory finish.

dishes.name: SAUERKRAUT FILLET 酸菜鱼
dishes.description: Tender fish fillets gently cooked with pickled mustard greens in a bright, savory and tangy broth, finished with fresh scallions. Refreshing and flavorful, with a balanced acidity that highlights the delicate taste of the fish.

dishes.name: BAMBOO SHOOTS WITH PICKLED GREENS 小笋炒泡菜
dishes.description: Tender baby bamboo shoots stir-fried with pickled greens for a bright, tangy crunch. Fresh, spicy, and appetizing, with the fermented aroma that makes Hunan cooking so distinctive.

dishes.name: HOT & SOUR SHREDDED POTATOES 酸辣土豆丝
dishes.description: Crisp shredded potatoes. Stir-fried with bird's eye chilies, pickled chilies, jalapeños, garlic leaves, and black vinegar

dishes.name: FIVE SPICE TOFU WITH PEPPERS 辣椒炒香干
dishes.description: A simple Hunan favorite with firm pressed tofu and fresh pepper aroma. Savory, smoky, and satisfying, with a clean plant-based richness.

dishes.name: STIR-FRIED CAULIFLOWER 橄榄油炒花菜
dishes.description: Cauliflower wok-fried until crisp-tender with a smoky, savory edge. Fragrant and layered, with the fresh aroma of olive oil that makes each bite more satisfying.

dishes.name: EGG FRIED RICE 蛋炒饭
dishes.description: Fluffy basmati rice wok-fried with organic egg until fragrant and golden. Clean, simple, and precise, made to pair beautifully with bold Hunan flavors.

dishes.name: WHITE RICE 白米饭
dishes.description: Choose classic steamed white rice or hearty brown rice. A simple, wholesome pairing for any dish.

dishes.name: BROWN RICE 粗粮饭
dishes.description: Choose classic steamed white rice or hearty brown rice. A simple, wholesome pairing for any dish.

dishes.name: KALE WITH GARLIC 橄榄油炒羽衣甘蓝
dishes.description: Fresh kale quickly wok-fried with garlic and olive oil for a clean, vibrant side dish. Light, savory, and aromatic, with the greens kept crisp and bright.

dishes.name: DRY-FRIED GREEN BEANS 橄榄油煸四季豆
dishes.description: Organic green beans stir-fried until crisp-tender and deeply aromatic with olive oil. A Hunan-style vegetable classic with savory garlic fragrance and satisfying flavor.

dishes.name: CABBAGE DRY POT 干锅包菜
dishes.description: Cabbage dry-wok fried until sweet, smoky, and crisp at the edges. Simple but expressive, showing how high heat can bring out deep flavor from humble vegetables.

dishes.name: CRISPY RICE CAKE 串串糍粑
dishes.description: Crisp-chewy glutinous rice cakes. Sweet, comforting, and nostalgic, with a deep caramel-like richness.

dishes.name: Golden Pumpkin Bun 南瓜馒头
dishes.description: Soft, fluffy pumpkin buns filled with sweet red bean paste and freshly steamed to order.

dishes.name: ICED LEMON TEA 大王冰柠檬茶
dishes.description: Chef Fei’s ultimate cooling companion. Fresh lemon and our signature tea blend are served ice-cold for a bright, refreshing finish. Handcrafted to order, it’s the killer combo with Stir-Fried Pork with Fresh Pepper.
